Fixes the failed run investigated in #46 (https://github.com/cv/pi-action/actions/runs/43174544345).

## What happened
The agent ran `git fetch origin '+refs/pi/*:refs/pi/*'`. That force-reset the local `refs/pi/threads/46`, which is the ref the run's `GitStorage` was writing. The next compare-and-swap commit failed, pi-durable failed the session, and `ThreadConversation.track()` logged a warning and dropped the trigger. Result: no reply, no reaction, and a green step. The `Save pi thread state` step then tried to push the rewound ref and warned "another writer moved it".
